findings.summary: The residual level set is rescaled to each case's own max |r| with no absolute floor (render.py:91) and then drawn at the same 2.0 pt weight as the physical DIII-D residual (render.py:141-150), so the MAST-21978-35 figure spends its heaviest ink on a 3.33e-16 Wb roundoff field contoured at +/-{0.2, 0.5, 0.8} x that maximum. In the rendered PNG the support-interior panel fills with tangled loops across the plasma core and the outside-plasma panel fills its outboard region, so those residual contours read as structure rather than as roundoff and partly cover the solved-flux contours beneath them. The reading is recoverable because the caption states the contours are floating-point roundoff and the maxima are labelled in aWb, which is why this does not block; a floor on drawn residual amplitude would remove the ambiguity.

notes: Read-only review. No file outside the two declared record paths was written, and no figure, caption or script was edited, redrawn, relabelled or reformatted. Every verdict was formed from the three named rendered PNGs at 1400x720 opened directly; no SVG and no other image was opened, read, listed, searched, rendered or git-shown, and the figure-to-path mapping was established from the regional node counts and maxima printed in the rendered captions. The reviewed head's figure records, palette log and drawing script were read as text for anchoring and for the caption check, not for the visual verdict.
